name: Terrarium 60x45x30
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x45x30 cm. Volume: 81.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The floor of this terrarium is 60x45 cm, which is 2700 cm², with a height of 30 cm and 81 liters of volume. None of our horizontal 60 cm long models has a wider floor. The low profile means everything inside can be reached through the sliding front glass.

Young Hermann's and Horsfield's tortoises use the 45 cm width to move in a circle, not just back and forth. A young blue-tongued skink needs the same. A kingsnake or a young ball python gets a floor that fits two hides side by side. For a bearded dragon this is a terrarium only for the first months of life.

A taller variant of the same floor exists as the 60x45x50. For adults of the species listed you later move on to a length of 100 cm or more. We make sizes on request in 7 to 14 days. On the outside it gets a film of your choice, and we ship it by courier to your address.
